source_shape: Tall upper-left rectangular slatted back, right-angle plank joints and hard seat angled down-right. Three source-visible support extents remain: long front-left, front-right and shorter rear-left; rear-right structure is occluded by the seat. Source back/seat proportions, gaps and footprint are authoritative.

palette.rule: Back/rails/supports receive primary w; the hard wooden seat surface receives detail y. This is a color role, not evidence that the seat is cloth. Cyan seat is only an extraction aid; final layers are neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed legacy Things/Seating/SquareChair sprite supplies clean straight-frame contours and restrained bevel shading. It is retained installed reference art, not claimed as the active current VFE definition. Its smooth/padded seat, unslatted rectangular back, donor footprint/facings and gameplay are not copied.

rejected_reference_note: VTE DiningChair_south and the previously extracted Core chair were viewed but their round backs/soft seats do not match the source plank structure; neither is selected for this refinement.
construction: Source nailed-plank chair with two inner back slats and upper/lower rails; hard rectangular plank seat with independent source tint. Side shows back edge and full seat depth with front/rear supports. Rear draws back posts above seat, preserving occlusion and source identity.
native_state: One fixed native chair tile. BaseChair supplies native Chair interaction,20-weight non-takeable organic furniture, MissileCover10, non-occlusion and rare Animated builder. No source facing selector or occupied tile is declared; rare animated/custom shapes require original fallback.

frame.rule: One complete source-cell mapping for back, hard seat, supports and masks. No independent seat/back/foot bbox centering.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; native non-takeable20-weight Chair interaction, MissileCover10, non-occlusion, rare Animated fallback and extra-view placement remain unfinished.

camera.contract: Retain corrected cardinal south plank chair. Complete right profile has broad rectangular hard seat and edge-on tall back. Rear back posts occlude the hard seat instead of being painted behind it.
camera.depth_status: Authored hidden seat depth guided by source proportions and legacy directional map camera; no runtime donor physical dimension inferred.
camera.unseen: Rear/side plank joinery, far-support overlap and nail heads are authored continuation of the same right-angle frame. No padded seat, canvas, rounded back, armrests or new mechanism.
camera.west: Mirror east; no asymmetric marks or side fittings.

source_camera_boundary: Original Qud art has an oblique hard seat and offset support extents. Preserve its parts/materials/palette in a new cardinal presentation; do not trace its camera or claim source-pixel position is native facing data.

directional_reference.binding: These are actual installed LEGACY SquareChair textures. Current1.6 Seat_SquareChair resolves NewThings/Furniture/SchoolChair/SchoolChair instead, so its Graphic_Multi/drawSize1x1 do not establish a render mapping for the selected legacy images.
directional_reference.missing: Active render mapping for selected legacy path is not exported; no physical measurement inferred from alpha width or current unrelated path.
directional_reference.role: Actual installed legacy VFE chair S/E/N establishes straight cardinal frame/seat convention only. It is not a structural replacement: source slatted back and hard nailed planks remain authoritative.
